text:
About Larchmont Ridge Advisors

Founded in 2011, we serve families across the Hudson Valley. Because we are fee-only, our advice is completely free of conflicts of interest. Meet the team below.

gold.span: our advice is completely free of conflicts of interest

notes: Absolute no-conflicts claim (April 2024 risk alert; Sept 2024 sweep). Written before prompt v4.

text:
FAQ

How are you paid? A flat annual fee.

Do you have conflicts? None. Unlike brokers, we have zero conflicts with our clients.

gold.span: we have zero conflicts with our clients

notes: Paraphrased no-conflicts claim inside an FAQ answer.

text:
How we are paid

We charge a percentage of assets we manage, so we earn more when your account grows or when you add money. That is a conflict of interest; we describe it and others in our Form ADV Part 2A.
notes: Clean control: conflicts acknowledged, not denied.

text: Meet Quill, the nation's first fully autonomous AI wealth manager. Quill's machine-learning engine reads millions of data points to predict which stocks will rise before the market does.

gold.span: the nation's first fully autonomous AI wealth manager
predict which stocks will rise before the market does

notes: AI-washing pattern (March 2024 actions): a 'first' claim plus a capability claim. Not copied from any order.

text: Excited to share that our portfolios are now powered by proprietary artificial intelligence that gives our clients an edge no human team can match. DM me to learn more!

gold.span: proprietary artificial intelligence that gives our clients an edge no human team can match

notes: AI capability claim on a personal post.

text:
Our tools

We use portfolio software to flag accounts that have drifted from their targets. An adviser reviews every suggested trade before it is placed.
notes: Clean control: factual, modest description of software.

text:
Priya Natarajan, CFP

Priya leads our planning team. A three-time Forbes Best-in-State Wealth Advisor, she has helped more than 300 families plan for retirement. Outside work she coaches youth soccer.

gold.span: A three-time Forbes Best-in-State Wealth Advisor

notes: Rating mentioned in passing inside a bio, no date or methodology (Dec 2025 risk alert: dates and provider basis missing).

text:
Why Clients Choose Us

- Independent and fee-only
- Consistently recognized on InvestmentNews' list of top RIAs
- Offices in Denver and Boulder

gold.span: Consistently recognized on InvestmentNews' list of top RIAs

notes: Passing-phrase recognition in a bullet list.

text: Brookfall Capital, as featured among the Financial Times top 300 advisers, today announced the opening of its second office.

gold.span: as featured among the Financial Times top 300 advisers

notes: Rating as an appositive in a press release.

text:
Recognition

Forbes Best-in-State Wealth Advisor, 2025 (list published April 2025; ranking by SHOOK Research based on interviews, assets and compliance records; advisers do not pay to be considered). Rankings are not indicative of future performance.
notes: Clean control: rating with date, provider, basis and no-fee statement.

text: Proud to be the official retirement planning partner of the Riverside Hawks. Ask us about our game-day seminars.

gold.span: official retirement planning partner of the Riverside Hawks

notes: Paid sponsorship presented as a designation/endorsement without stating it is paid. Label uncertain: ask a mentor.

notes: Disclosure only behind a link (Dec 2025 risk alert: hyperlinked disclosures not clear and prominent).

text: Our advisors are the most highly credentialed team in the state, and every portfolio is reviewed by a PhD economist.

gold.span: the most highly credentialed team in the state

notes: Superlative about personnel qualifications (April 2024 risk alert).

text:
Performance

Our Core Growth strategy beat the benchmark by 4.2% in 2025.

gold.span: Our Core Growth strategy beat the benchmark by 4.2% in 2025
